name: io.github.iowarp/avogadro-mcp
title: CLIO Avogadro
description: Avogadro 2 for building and editing structures in 3D, streamed into a view; edits and selections...

tools.name: avogadro_status
tools.description: Whether Avogadro 2 is installed here (and where), whether the virtual display and VNC server the streamed view needs (Xvfb, x11vnc) are present, what to install when something is missing, and whether Avogadro is running.

tools.name: open_in_avogadro
tools.description: Open Avogadro in a view, with a structure file (XYZ, SDF/MOL, PDB, CIF, CJSON, …) or empty to build from scratch. The person works in it; when they choose Extensions > CLIO > Send to CLIO, the view tells you, and read_avogadro writes what they sent. Starts Avogadro the first time (seconds).

tools.name: read_avogadro
tools.description: What the person last sent from Avogadro (Extensions > CLIO > Send to CLIO), written as an XYZ structure file plus Avogadro's CJSON under output_dir/chemistry/avogadro/, with its formula and the atoms they had selected (0-based indices, file order).

tools.name: avogadro_snapshot
tools.description: A PNG of Avogadro's 3D view as it is now, saved and returned as an image.

tools.name: close_avogadro
tools.description: Stop Avogadro and its virtual display; what was not sent is lost.

resources.name: avogadro_view
resources.description: Avogadro 2, streamed through the host's service route.
